10.notes: SSC (board exam) year. Book imprint pages read 'Republished 2025, 2026' with no revision note, so the 2025-26 and 2026-27 editions have the same chapter lists. Current Physical Science has NO 'Heat' or 'Refraction of Light at Plane Surfaces' chapter; those topics (specific heat, Snell's law, total internal reflection, critical angle) are in the Class 9 Physical Science book. An Environmental Education book (29 project-style lessons) is also prescribed; it is not a separate SSC theory paper.
